name: National Alliance for Water Innovation (NAWI)
program: NAWI RFPs (energy-water hub; 2026 Industrial Water Reuse RFP NAWI-4-2026)
collect_note: The NAWI Opportunities page lists each RFP under Current and Past; the list adapter keeps Current RFP links (the application itself sits on a JavaScript InfoReady portal), skips past PDFs and the RFI, and no deadline is on the listing so it is read from the RFP page by hand. The engine keeps a route hash, so each InfoReady competition link keeps its own url and external_id (here https://nawi.infoready4.com/#competitionDetail/2000555).
